- Then `[` gives `[`, `(` gives `[ (`, `[` gives `[ ( [`, and the final `]` pops back to `[ (`.

`( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ] ) ]`

- Its explanation says to append `] ) ] )`, but the submitted string actually appends `) ] ) ]`. The explanation and the answer disagree, and neither is correct.
